subject: RE: Incentive trip - 38 guests, three nights in May
body:
Hi Rickard,

Thank you for thinking of us for the team. For a group of this size and length of stay, our best rate is EUR 153 per night for the group - that is 15% off our EUR 180 rack rate, held for you. I know that is short of the 22% you asked for; 15% is our floor for group business without a manager's sign-off, and I have already flagged this one for that conversation, so I may be able to come back with a little more.

If 15% works in the meantime, tell me and I will place a provisional hold for your three nights in May.

Warm regards,
Hotel Aurora Sales & Events
